decisions.reason: The IMU module is an established building block with sunk design and firmware investment and fits the move to newer connectors, so management continues to back it.
Its dedicated product page is a visible public commitment, and it supports the announced energy-management direction, so any weak results are read as temporary.
The relay module is cheap to keep, close to the core automation line and complements other modules, so dropping it would not be justified.
The kit only bundles existing modules and is peripheral to the strategic direction, but carrying it costs little and earlier decisions to keep it argue for persistence.
The newly launched RGB LED module builds on the modular platform, and one year is too early to judge, so any slow uptake is attributed to ramp-up.
The wallbox remote access service is central to the announced expansion of charging and energy management, so management is strongly committed to it.
